title: Sominus Voodoo dolls
description: The mod adds voodoo dolls - messengers of the magic of voodooism, make the people around you become your dolls!
body:
**Lore**
 
 A someone called Sominus the one who wanted a revenge on his enemy made the magical dolls based on voodoo magic. That dools has a lot of energy inside what can kill anybody by name it by player nickname and burnt.

 _Plugin workng only in russian._

  **How to rename?**
  "Кукла вуду "Nickname""

  **Как переименовать?**
  "Кукла вуду "Ник""
